_comment: Reference clips and their counterfactual object variants. 'action' must refer to the object as 'the object' (it is substituted per variant). Files are resolved against --video-dir. Variant category is 'size' (same shape, different dimensions) or 'shape' (different geometry); dims are rough targets for the sim-side asset and for later checking reconstructed scale.

IMG_5689.object: a small white rounded plastic earbuds case
IMG_5689.action: reaches over the object, grasps it from above with the fingertips, lifts it, carries it to the right and sets it down, releases it, then grasps it again, carries it back to the left, sets it down near the center of the table and withdraws the arm

variants.description: a large white rounded plastic case about twice the size of an earbuds case
